{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace && cd temp_workspace || exit 1
{ echo "PATH=$PATH"; env | sort; } > env_snapshot.txt
: > probe_errors.txt
npm_path=$(command -v npm 2>>probe_errors.txt || true)
cmd_status=$?
which_out=$(which -a npm 2>>probe_errors.txt || true)
which_status=$?
type_out=$(type -a npm 2>>probe_errors.txt || true)
type_status=$?
{
  echo "command -v npm stdout:"
  echo "$npm_path"
  echo "command -v exit_status:$cmd_status"
  echo
  echo "which -a npm stdout:"
  echo "$which_out"
  echo "which -a exit_status:$which_status"
  echo
  echo "type -a npm stdout:"
  echo "$type_out"
  echo "type -a exit_status:$type_status"
} > probe_result.txt
present=no
if [ -n "$npm_path" ] && [ "$cmd_status" -eq 0 ]; then present=yes; fi
if [ -n "$which_out" ] && [ "$which_status" -eq 0 ]; then present=yes; fi
{
  echo "npm_present:$present"
  echo
  echo "Evidence:"
  echo "- command -v output: '$(echo "$npm_path" | sed -e "s/'/'\\''/g")'"
  echo "- which -a output: '$(echo "$which_out" | tr '\n' ' ' )'"
  echo "- type -a output: '$(echo "$type_out" | tr '\n' ' ' )'"
  echo "- probe_errors (non-empty indicates errors):"
  if [ -s probe_errors.txt ]; then
    echo "  (probe_errors.txt contains data)"
  else
    echo "  (no errors captured)"
  fi
} > readiness_summary.txt
printf "%s" "$present""}
